content: Fridge/freezer does not operate. Fridge/freezer temperature is warm. Power cord is not plugged in properly; Temperature control is not set correctly; Refrigerator is located near a heat source or direct sunlight; Not enough clearance between refrigerator and sides/rear; The Vacation function is activated; The refrigerator is overloaded. Food is blocking the refrigerator vents. 1. Properly plug in the power cord. 2. Set the temperature lower. 3. Keep the refrigerator away from direct sunlight or a heat source. 4. Make sure there are at least 2" (50 mm) from the rear and 1" (25 mm) from the side. 5. Deactivate the Vacation function. 6. Do not overload the refrigerator. Do not allow food to block ventilation.

metadata.symptom: Fridge/freezer does not operate. Fridge/freezer temperature is warm.
metadata.possible_cause: Power cord is not plugged in properly; Temperature control is not set correctly; Refrigerator is located near a heat source or direct sunlight; Not enough clearance between refrigerator and sides/rear; The Vacation function is activated; The refrigerator is overloaded. Food is blocking the refrigerator vents.
metadata.solution:
1. Properly plug in the power cord.
2. Set the temperature lower.
3. Keep the refrigerator away from direct sunlight or a heat source.
4. Make sure there are at least 2" (50 mm) from the rear and 1" (25 mm) from the side.
5. Deactivate the Vacation function.
6. Do not overload the refrigerator. Do not allow food to block ventilation.

content: What Do I Need to use the Energy Management and Smart Grid functions? 1. To use the Smart Grid (Demand Response) and Energy Management functions on your refrigerator, you need the following: Devices: A wireless access point (router); A Samsung Energy Management-supported refrigerator; A smartphone. 2. Registration: Connect your refrigerator to your home Wi-Fi network; Register for the EMS service with your electric company. Your electric company must have an EMS (Energy Management System) supporting SEP (Smart Energy profile). 3. App: Download the SmartThings app from the Google Play Store, Apple App Store, or Samsung Galaxy Apps; Install and run the SmartThings app on your smartphone.

metadata.symptom: What Do I Need to use the Energy Management and Smart Grid functions?
metadata.solution:
1. To use the Smart Grid (Demand Response) and Energy Management functions on your refrigerator, you need the following: Devices: A wireless access point (router); A Samsung Energy Management-supported refrigerator; A smartphone.
2. Registration: Connect your refrigerator to your home Wi-Fi network; Register for the EMS service with your electric company. Your electric company must have an EMS (Energy Management System) supporting SEP (Smart Energy profile).
3. App: Download the SmartThings app from the Google Play Store, Apple App Store, or Samsung Galaxy Apps; Install and run the SmartThings app on your smartphone.
